description: This file defines the NotesService class, which implements business logic for managing notes in a note-taking application. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, updating, and deleting notes, utilizing an asynchronous database session and a notes repository.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: Provides asynchronous business logic methods for managing notes, including CRUD operations and error handling.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when a note is not found.

methods.name: Note create_note(self, payload: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note from the provided payload containing title and content.

methods.name: Note get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID or raises NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of all notes ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Note update_note(self, note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate)
methods.description: Updates the specified fields of a note by ID or raises NotFoundError.

methods.name: None delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID or raises NotFoundError.

ctags.name: create_note
ctags.pattern: /^    async def create_note(self, payload: NoteCreate) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: delete_note
ctags.pattern: /^    async def delete_note(self, note_id: int) -> None:$/

ctags.name: get_note
ctags.pattern: /^    async def get_note(self, note_id: int) -> Note:$/

ctags.name: update_note
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update_note(self, note_id: int, payload: NoteUpdate) -> Note:$/
